brand.name: Team Crafties
brand.tone: warm, handmade, beginner-friendly, clean enough for printable pattern pages

realistic-finished-project.label: Realistic finished craft/project photo
realistic-finished-project.best_for: Finished plush, candle, jewelry, soap, yarn, or craft-table hero images where prompt reasoning matters.
realistic-finished-project.prompt_template: Create a realistic finished-project photograph for a Team Crafties pattern. Subject: {title}. Craft type: {craft}. Details: {details}. Warm natural light on a cozy craft table, real handmade materials, believable scale, visible texture, soft shadows, no poster text, no watermark, no official logos. Keep it practical and maker-usable, not glossy AI advertising. Team Crafties palette accents: purple, lilac, teal, soft yellow, pink.

crochet-texture-photo.label: Crochet/yarn texture-focused photo
crochet-texture-photo.best_for: Crochet, knitting, macramé, yarn texture, plush or soft goods where material realism matters more than text.
crochet-texture-photo.prompt_template: Photorealistic close-up of the finished handmade yarn craft for a Team Crafties pattern: {title}. Craft type: {craft}. Details: {details}. Emphasize real yarn fibers, stitch direction, soft stuffing, natural handmade imperfections, cozy table styling, shallow depth of field, warm daylight. No text, no labels, no watermark, no official logos.

pattern-cover-recraft.label: Recraft-style clean pattern cover / branded graphic
pattern-cover-recraft.best_for: Pattern covers, printable title cards, clean thumbnails, icons, labels, and branded social graphics.
pattern-cover-recraft.prompt_template: Design a clean, production-ready Team Crafties pattern cover graphic for: {title}. Craft type: {craft}. Details: {details}. Friendly polished editorial layout, rounded soft shapes, purple/lilac/teal/yellow/pink palette, cute handmade accents, generous whitespace, print-friendly, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no official logos. If text is included, keep it short and legible: Team Crafties.

text-label-graphic.label: Text/label-heavy image
text-label-graphic.best_for: Short labels, covers with readable words, announcement cards, and social squares.
text-label-graphic.prompt_template: A polished Team Crafties graphic with clear readable text. Main text: {title}. Supporting idea: {details}. Friendly handmade craft brand, purple hippo-community feeling without copying the mascot unless requested, soft lilac and teal, clean typography, no watermark, no official logos.

social-square.label: Square Instagram/Facebook promo graphic
social-square.best_for: Simple shareable social images for a new free pattern or community prompt.
social-square.prompt_template: Create a square social media graphic for Team Crafties. Topic: {title}. Craft type: {craft}. Details: {details}. Simple warm composition, one strong image area, one short readable headline, lots of breathing room, cozy handmade palette, friendly not childish, no watermark, no official logos.

local-pattern-cover-svg.label: Local clean pattern cover SVG
local-pattern-cover-svg.best_for: No-credit, deterministic printable covers and placeholder thumbnails. Useful when paid image backends are blocked.
local-pattern-cover-svg.prompt_template: Local Team Crafties cover for {title}. Craft type: {craft}. Details: {details}.

assembly-diagram-svg.label: Deterministic assembly / stitch-step diagram
assembly-diagram-svg.best_for: Exact pattern helper diagrams: pieces, rounds, assembly order, labels, and safety notes. Use this when accuracy matters more than photorealism.
